utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. This is case number IT-01-48-I, the Prosecutor of the Tribunal against Sefer Halilovic. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] I would like the two parties to introduce themselves, please. MS. DEL PONTE: [Interpretation] Mr. President, my name is Carla Del Ponte, Chief Prosecutor. With me is my colleague Carl Koenig. Thank you, Mr. President. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] And for the Defence, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. BALIJAGIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, Mr. President, my name is Faruk Balijagic. I'm an attorney, the only and lead Defence counsel for the accused Sefer Halilovic at this stage of the proceedings. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Thank you. Mr. Halilovic, are you able to follow the proceedings in a language you understand? Can you hear me, Mr. Halilovic? Can you hear me? Are you able to follow the proceedings in a language you know?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can hear you. Yes, I am able to follow the proceedings in my language, and I do understand. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Will you please give us your name. Spell your name for us, first and last name, age, your occupation.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] My name is Sefer, S-e-f-e-r, Halilovic, H-a-l-i-l-o-v-i-c. I was born on the 6th of January, 1952. I am living in Sarajevo. And until now, I was Minister in the government of the Republic of Bosnia-Herzegovina. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] This is your initial appearance before this Tribunal. This formal occasion is essential, and on this occasion, you will be able to hear all the charges made against you by the Office of the Prosecutor. Have you received the indictment in your own language?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I have received the indictment in my language. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Have you understood the content of the indictment?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I haven't fully understood the indictment. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] But have you understood the charges against you? Have you discussed them with your counsel?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I understand that I am accused and charged. I have talked to my Defence counsel, but I have not understood the indictment. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Do you wish the indictment to be read out to you in its integrity [sic] at this hearing? This is your right, but you are also entitled to waive that right. Do you wish the indictment to be read out to you in full?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I waive the right to have the indictment read out to me because I have read it. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] I therefore take note of the fact that you have waived that right. We are now going to proceed with the initial proceedings, which is -- and the major point of these proceedings, that is your pleading, guilty or not guilty. You're able to tell us now whether you wish to plead guilty or not guilty, unless you wish to do so later, within a time period of 30 days. So we are going to read the counts against you, and you will tell us whether you plead guilty or not guilty. Madam Registrar, will you please read out the counts.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I do wish to plead now. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Once you have heard the charges, you will then plead guilty or not guilty.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 1, murder, a violation of the laws or customs of war, punishable under Article 3 of the Statute of the Tribunal and recognised by Article 3(1)(a) of the Geneva Conventions, and Article 7(3) of the Statute of the Tribunal. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] How do you plead, guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On behalf of merciful God, I declare that I am not guilty. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] I take note, Mr. Halilovic, that you plead not guilty of this count. Madam Registrar, will you take note of that, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Madam Prosecutor, I wish to remind you of your obligations under Rule 66(A)(i) of the Rules of procedure and Evidence, that is the disclosure of the supporting material within 30 days. MS. DEL PONTE: [Interpretation] Yes, Mr. President. We have already -- we already have the supporting material attached to the indictment, which is ready to be served on the Defence counsel after the hearing. I should like to specify that we do not have the complete translations into all the languages of the Tribunal - because, as you know, we always have that problem - but we shall do our best to have the translations within 30 days. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Translation into the language of the accused? They will be ready in 30 days? MS. DEL PONTE: [Interpretation] Yes, all of it. We already have a part of it translated, but within 30 days, we should be able to provide the complete translations of all the documents. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] I take note of that. Thank you. I should now like to address the Defence counsel, to remind you of 22 Rule 72(or rule 62[sic])that preliminary motions may be filed within 30 days. Mr. Balijagic, you have 30 days for filing those preliminary motions.

utterances.speaker: MR. BALIJAGIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Honourable Court, I take note of that, and I should like to notify Your Honour that both I and my client will fully cooperate with the Tribunal, because we hold the -- attach the greatest importance to the establishment of the truth, whatever it turns out to be. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Thank you. Please sit down, Mr. Halilovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. BALIJAGIC
utterances.text: JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] I wish to underline that this case has been assigned to Chamber III and the Pre-Trial Judge will be named shortly. Defence counsel, is there anything that you wish to raise at this stage of the proceedings? I'm talking to you, Mr. Balijagic. Do you have any points to make?

utterances.speaker: MR. BALIJAGIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, on this occasion, I have nothing further to add. Once I have received the supporting material attached to the indictment, I will address Your Honours in written form. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Madam Prosecutor, do you have any points to make at this stage? MS. DEL PONTE: No, Mr. President. I just wish to welcome the statement regarding cooperation between the Court and the accused and his Defence counsel. JUDGE FASSI FIHRI: [Interpretation] Before adjourning, I wish to thank the interpreters and the technical staff for their invaluable cooperation. The hearing is adjourned.
